title: Link
overview: Navigation to another page, section, or document — not a commit on this screen.
apply_when: The press takes them somewhere: a URL, an in-page target, a download, Back.
not_when: The press does something here (save, submit, delete, open a dialog). That is button.

vs.why: commits an action on this screen

role.apply_when: A sentence or paragraph that names where they go.
role.not_when: A whole card wrapped in one link so AT reads everything as the name.

role.overview: A destination in chrome: nav, back, skip.
role.apply_when: Getting to another view or past repeated chrome.

role.overview: A destination that fetches a file.
role.not_when: A button that starts an upload.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.apply_when: The verb or page name is enough.
composition.not_when: The control has no visible text and no accessible name.

composition.apply_when: A known destination that still needs words.

composition.overview: The link is its own hit area, not wrapping a whole card.
composition.apply_when: Back, skip, inline, or a named nav item.
composition.not_when: Wrapping a content_card so the card is one giant link.

state.overview: Not visited this session as a required cue — still a link.
state.not_when: Styled as body text with no affordance.

state.overview: Pointer is over the link — extra cue, not the only cue.
state.apply_when: A mouse or trackpad can reach it.
state.not_when: Underline only on hover (fails on touch).

state.overview: Keyboard or AT is on this link. Must stay visible.
They have been to this destination. Optional extra cue.
state.not_when: Visited color is the only way to know it is a link.

accessibility.overview: The link names the destination, not 'click here'.
accessibility.apply_when: Any link, especially icon-only or a repeated 'Read more'.
accessibility.not_when: The only name is the URL or 'click here'.

accessibility.apply_when: Touch or inline links that must not collide.
accessibility.not_when: A 12px text link with no padding.

accessibility.overview: If it opens a new window, the name says so.
accessibility.apply_when: target=_blank or a download that leaves the page.
accessibility.not_when: A surprise new window with no name change.

keyboard.overview: Tab lands on the link in a logical order.
keyboard.not_when: Skip links are not first, or the link is not focusable.
Enter does nothing because it was faked as a click-only span.
